run_relax_atoms: run a relaxation on ASE atoms using the FIRE optimizer with default 500 steps and 0.02 fmax
run_relax_atoms_with_symmetry: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with fix_symmetry enabled to preserve structural symmetry
run_relax_atoms_with_cell_filter: run a relaxation on ASE atoms using a cell filter class to relax cell parameters
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with observer callbacks attached at specified intervals
run_relax_atoms_custom_optimizer: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with a custom optimizer class and convergence threshold
